rationale: Reproduction check rather than a new claim. The newest and most consequential witness recorded under the multi-voter question is that, eight seconds after healing, the isolated node and the majority-side leader hold different entries at the same log index while both had acknowledged their client writes (receipt a608e5f60ae4415981c1024522a24a0d, witness event index 27, control 29). That observation is window and schedule dependent by nature, and the run's own limitations say so, so re-executing the same fixed experiment from its retained inputs in a clean copy tests whether the disagreement reappears without any change to the scenario, the isolation timing, the eight-second heal or the declaration. If it reappears the witness is reproducible; if it does not, the limitation that the outcome depends on the window is the accurate reading and the earlier receipt stands as one complete execution. No experiment, interpretation or stop is submitted alongside this repeat.
